messages:
ashley-sales: Pegasus AI asked for a short perf POC next week. Targets: sustain 300 qps, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms, show coldstart behavior, and customer KMS for embeddings. Need runbook + ballpark committed price.

devin-eng: We'll run two profiles: hosted control and dedicated reserved. What are sample sizes/sequence lengths?

ashley-sales: They sent sample traces: median 210 tokens in, 125 out, ~75% session reuse.

devin-eng: Good for KV/prefix caching. Rough token load = 300*(210+125)=~100.5k tok/s. At ~12k tok/s per GPU -> ~9 GPUs with headroom. Batching cap ~20ms, cache enabled.

rachel-ops: Draft runbook: provision 9 GPUs (min 6/max 12 autoscale), enable KV cache & batching cap 20ms, session-aware Poisson traffic, 30m steady @300 qps, 10m microburst @900 qps, 5 coldstart cycles, KMS rotation test. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, GPU util, queueing, KMS latency.

omar-sre: kms-bot: "KMS NOTE: Customer-managed CMK is supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption; for in-path CMK recommend Dedicated in same VPC to minimize latency."

lee-qa: I'll build the harness and capture tail percentiles and coldstart warmup curves. Include a hosted run to show delta on p95/p99 and unit cost.

rachel-ops: Ballpark for procurement: Dedicated (9 GPUs reserved + infra/support): "$80k/month" placeholder. Hosted 1mo PoC (managed): "$27k". I'll refine numbers in the runbook.

devin-eng: Note KMS impact: synchronous CMK calls can add ~10-20ms if cross-region; in-VPC Dedicated ~5-10ms. Recommend DEK envelope pattern or async KMS auth for embeddings to avoid critical path.

omar-sre: Ops fallback: if p95 > SLO for >2min route to fallback smaller model variant and alert on degraded QoS. Pre-warm one standby node to reduce cold starts.

ashley-sales: Timeline: runbook final Mon EOD, infra Tue, run Wed-Thu, analysis Fri. I'll send one-page summary after results (p50/p95/p99, tokens/M cost, recommended commit, security notes). Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
